description:
AI score (0-10) for how likely one address is to engage, with the signals behind it.
When to use: When the user asks how good or engaged an address is, beyond valid/invalid.
Parameters: email — address to score; usePost (optional) — send as POST.
CREDITS: Each successful call spends ZeroBounce account credits. Confirm with the user before calling unless they explicitly asked for validation, enrichment, or activity data.

usePost.description: When true, uses POST with form-encoded api_key and email

name: score_email
title: Score email
